snippet.title: Prehistorik 2: Full playthrough in HD
snippet.description:
I found my DOSBOX in my folder and I decided to give my old games another go on it. I remember playing Prehistorik 2 in the early 2000's when I was still young. I loved this game since it had so many secret passages and its atmosphere was fun.

Another bonus is that the maps themselves are nice, vibrant, and colorful, unlike most of the co-op maps in Starcraft. Enjoy!
